curatedMovie.curiosityHook: How can Frank protect Danny after becoming the only person to believe him?
curatedMovie.description: Divorced father Frank Morrison faces an agonizing crisis when his 12-year-old son Danny, known for telling tall tales, claims his mother's new husband committed a murder.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A lean, suspenseful family thriller that moves steadily through escalating dread and protective urgency.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Harold Becker directs an efficient 89-minute domestic thriller that channels genuine parental dread as a father becomes the sole believer standing between his boy and danger.
